pnl_risks: Running the dovish read as a position: the page's own call is NO TRADE / NO EDGE (context-only rope net, null meeting probabilities, FedWatch 403), so buying the front end off the +29k print means overriding the artifact's stated abstention without verifiable odds - the single largest way to lose money here.

Tenor mismatch on the proxies: ZQV26 (3.88%) is an October 30-day average set mostly before the Oct 28 decision, and CRAU26 (2.346%) averages a quarter spanning both the Oct 28 and Dec 9 BoC decisions - any hedge ratio around a single meeting is a guess, because neither contract can be decomposed into meeting odds.

Quote quality: CRAU26 carries no executed print in this capture (last 0; bid/ask 97.6525/97.655; sizes 140/277; Friday sweep 97.645-97.66), so execution on illiquid weekend quotes can differ materially from the marked level, and the +9.6 bp carry over target is not riskless.

Two-sided data risk into a dated event stack: ISM services (Oct 5; prior 55.4), FOMC minutes (Oct 7), claims (Oct 8), Canada LFS and Michigan (Oct 9) - a hot services or prices echo re-arms the hawkish tail (prices-paid 77.9; Michigan expectations 4.6%), while the -60k revision cushion is vulnerability, not insurance, on a +29k print that can itself be revised.

Long-end divergence: the front end rallied on the print (ZN +0.25% window, SPY +0.74%) while the long end kept bleeding (TLT -0.30% d, -2.32% w) - trading 'the Fed is done' as a duration position fights the part of the tape that is actually moving.

Pre-refresh media odds: the still-quoted >70% October hike probability predates Friday's payrolls shock and is unverifiable here (FedWatch 403); the page correctly marks it as stale context, but acting on it after the September report means trading on superseded information.
